title: Chapter 13 Statement of Your Current Monthly Income and Calculation of Commitment Period
notes: The Chapter 13 CMI statement (issue #365): lines 2-11 are the same § 101(10A) derivation B122A-1 prints (core/cmi.py); lines 12-21 are the means-test engine's Chapter 13 branch (core/means_test.py) — the marital adjustment subtracted BEFORE the median comparison (§ 1325(b)(3), line 17) and the separate commitment-period comparison (§ 1325(b)(4), line 21). Known defects, verified by widget geometry: nearly every amount box is named undefined_NN, the geometry is the identity; the net business and rental boxes (undefined_6.*, undefined_10.*) are shared with the column 'copy here' boxes; line 11's combined total (undefined_32) is reused for lines 12 and 18, line 14 (undefined_38) for 15a, line 16c (undefined_41) for 20c, line 19b (undefined_43) for 20a, and line 13's total (undefined_37) for its own copy box — one value, two printed boxes, always agreeing; line 15b's widget (undefined_40) has a second, orphaned instance below page 2's bottom edge; line 16a and 16b are named after their prose captions.
